title: HubSpot Sales Hub Pricing in 2026: Seats, Onboarding and Calling Minutes
summary: HubSpot Sales Hub: Starter from $7 (regular $20), Professional $90 plus $1,500 onboarding, Enterprise $150 plus $3,500, per seat a month. See calling limits.
body_markdown:
HubSpot publishes Sales Hub prices per seat. On November 18, 2026, Starter showed $7 per seat a month paid annually, or $10 paid monthly, both as new-customer discounts beside a regular $20. Professional is $90 paid annually, or $100 paid monthly on an annual commitment, plus a required one-time $1,500 onboarding fee. Enterprise starts at $150, plus $3,500 onboarding. Calling is capped at 500, 3,000 and 12,000 minutes a month.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. Every HubSpot detail below comes from HubSpot's own pricing page, Product & Services Catalog, knowledge base and customer terms, opened on November 18, 2026. No price here comes from a review site. No HubSpot account was used and nothing was tested. For the calling routes inside HubSpot, see[how to make calls from HubSpot](https://www.trellus.ai/post/how-to-make-calls-from-hubspot) .


## HubSpot Sales Hub pricing at a glance


HubSpot's[Sales Hub pricing page](https://www.hubspot.com/pricing/sales) shows four columns: Free, Starter, Professional and Enterprise. Starter and Professional have a switch between Pay Monthly and Pay Annually.


HubSpot Sales Hub plans per seat a month in US dollars, from HubSpot's own pricing page and Product & Services Catalog, read on November 18, 2026. Plan Pay Annually Pay Monthly Required onboarding Seat minimum Free trial What is included for calling


Free tools $0 $0 None Up to 2 users Free plan; no credit card No calling minutes listed


Starter $7 for new customers; regular $20 $10 for new customers, on a monthly commitment; regular $20 None None stated; one Core Seat included None stated 500 calling minutes a month and 1 HubSpot-provided phone number


Professional $90 $100, on an annual commitment $1,500, one time None stated; one Sales Seat included None stated 3,000 calling minutes a month, up to 3 HubSpot-provided numbers, conversation intelligence and sequences


Enterprise $150 Not listed $3,500, one time None stated; one Sales Seat included Talk to Sales 12,000 calling minutes a month, up to 5 HubSpot-provided numbers and the sales power dialer


The Starter card carries the note "Discounts available for new customers only". It shows $7 with Pay Annually selected, beside a crossed-out $20, and $10 with Pay Monthly. The page does not say how long the discount lasts. HubSpot's[catalog](https://legal.hubspot.com/hubspot-product-and-services-catalog/products) lists Sales Hub Starter at $20 a month per Core Seat.


The catalog lists Professional at $100 a month per Sales Seat, and Enterprise at $150 billed annually. It shows one included seat on each edition. The pricing page states no seat minimum and no free trial of the paid editions.


## What changes the real cost of HubSpot Sales Hub


The seat price is public. The bill also depends on the commitment, the onboarding fee, which seat type each user needs, and how many minutes the team calls.


### Paying monthly or annually


On Starter, the Pay Monthly option is labelled "Commit monthly". On Professional it is labelled "Commit annually". So $100 a month on Professional is still a one-year commitment. Paying the year up front brings it to $90. Enterprise has no switch on the page, and the catalog lists it as billed annually.


### The required onboarding fee


The Professional card says its cost does not include the required, one-time Professional Onboarding for a fee of $1,500. The Enterprise card says the same for Enterprise Onboarding at $3,500. Starter lists none. Ten Professional seats paid annually are $900 a month. Their first year is $10,800 in seats plus $1,500, or $12,300 before tax.


The catalog's[consulting services section](https://legal.hubspot.com/hubspot-product-and-services-catalog/consulting-services) says Sales Hub onboarding is delivered remotely by phone, Zoom and email. It runs for 60 days from purchase on Professional and 90 days on Enterprise.


### Seat types


The[catalog's pricing overview](https://legal.hubspot.com/hubspot-product-and-services-catalog) says full Sales Hub Professional or Enterprise functionality needs a Sales Seat, at $100 or $150 a month. Other users can take a Core Seat at $50 a month on Professional or $75 on Enterprise. View-Only Seats cost nothing.


The seat type decides who can call. HubSpot's article on[making calls in the browser](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/calling/make-calls-in-the-hubspot-browser) , last updated October 27, 2026, says an assigned Sales or Service seat is required to make calls on Professional and Enterprise. On Starter, users with a Core Seat can also call.


### Calling minutes are a monthly cap


The pricing page lists 500 calling minutes on Starter, 3,000 on Professional and 12,000 on Enterprise, and none in the Free column. The catalog lists the same figures per month. Its FAQ describes the Professional limit as 3,000 minutes of calling per account per month. On that wording the minutes are shared by the account, not given to each user. Ten reps on Professional would share 3,000 minutes, or 300 each.


The same FAQ says an account with Sales Hub Professional and Service Hub Professional still has 3,000 minutes, not 6,000.


HubSpot's[calling FAQ](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/calling/calling-frequently-asked-questions) , last updated August 14, 2026, says minutes reset at the start of the next month, not on the renewal date. Once they are used up, a call in progress can usually finish, but no new call can start until the reset. The browser article adds that the Call from phone option uses twice as many minutes, because it makes two separate calls.


### More minutes and more numbers


The catalog's[add-ons section](https://legal.hubspot.com/hubspot-product-and-services-catalog/add-ons) lists two limit increases for calling:


- **Calling Minute Limit Increase:** $50 a month for each pack of 1,000 more calling minutes a month. Unused minutes do not roll over.
- **HubSpot Phone Number Limit Increase:** $25 a month for each pack of 5 more phone numbers.


Both are listed as available to the Professional or Enterprise edition of Sales Hub or Service Hub. Neither is listed for Starter. A full pack works out to $0.05 a minute.


HubSpot's[phone numbers article](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/calling/acquire-and-validate-hubspot-provided-phone-numbers) , last updated November 16, 2026, says each account has a pooled limit of HubSpot-provided numbers. They are not supported in all countries.


A calling app is the other route. HubSpot's article on[third-party calling providers](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/calling/integrate-a-third-party-calling-provider-with-hubspot) lists it for all products and plans, and says an integrated calling app does not use the account's HubSpot calling minutes.


### The sales power dialer


HubSpot's article on the[sales power dialer](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/calling/use-the-sales-power) lists it on Sales Hub Enterprise only. It queues contacts from the Contacts index page and needs a HubSpot-provided number.


### Renewal and cancellation


HubSpot's[Customer Terms of Service](https://legal.hubspot.com/terms-of-service) , last modified September 16, 2026, say a subscription renews automatically for the same term or one year, whichever is shorter. A customer cannot cancel before the end of the current term, and prepaid fees are not refunded. To stop a renewal, turn off auto-renewal before the term ends. At renewal, HubSpot may raise fees up to its list price with 30 days' notice.


## Who HubSpot Sales Hub fits and who it does not


HubSpot describes Sales Hub as sales software built on its Smart CRM. That fits a team that wants its CRM, sequences, forecasting and calls in one account, with reps who call for part of the day.


Sales Hub is a weaker fit for a team that spends most of the day on the phone. The minutes are a monthly cap, extra minutes are sold in packs on Professional and Enterprise only, and the power dialer is on Enterprise. It is also a weaker fit for a small team that wants Professional features month to month, because Professional carries an annual commitment and a $1,500 onboarding fee.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does HubSpot Sales Hub cost per seat?


On November 18, 2026, HubSpot's pricing page showed Starter from $7 per seat a month paid annually or $10 paid monthly, as new-customer discounts beside $20. Professional starts at $90 paid annually or $100 paid monthly on an annual commitment. Enterprise starts at $150.


### Is there an onboarding fee for HubSpot Sales Hub?


Yes, on two plans. Professional has a required one-time onboarding fee of $1,500 and Enterprise one of $3,500. Neither is in the seat price. Starter lists none.


### How many calling minutes does HubSpot Sales Hub include?


500 a month on Starter, 3,000 on Professional and 12,000 on Enterprise. HubSpot's catalog describes the Professional limit as per account per month, so the minutes are shared. They reset at the start of each month.


### Can you buy more HubSpot calling minutes?


On Professional and Enterprise, yes. The Calling Minute Limit Increase is $50 a month for each 1,000 extra minutes a month, and unused minutes do not roll over. The catalog does not list it for Starter. A calling app does not use HubSpot's minutes.


### Which HubSpot plan includes the power dialer?


Sales Hub Enterprise. HubSpot's knowledge base lists the sales power dialer on that edition only. Starter and Professional place calls from a record or the Contacts index page.
